assessor: RTS implementation preflight — Child B compact active restart surface
rationale: The implementation is repository-local and read-only. It adds a fixed restart denominator, bounded active-load accounting, exact source-pointer freshness, explicit reopen conditions, restart-equivalence validation, and a selective-recall handoff. It never truncates required state to hit a budget and never grants execution or promotion authority.
existing_assumptions: Child A Selective Recall is COMPLETED and remains the owner of historical selective retrieval.
Full history remains stored in existing sources and is not deleted by compaction.
Git blob identity can bind local source freshness deterministically.
Restart representation is not execution authority.

data_migration.notes: No full-history source is rewritten or deleted.

approval_changes: restart outputs carry execution_authority=NONE and promotion_authority=NONE
only RTS-FRZ-000012 may enter WIP during this loop
rollback_boundary: Revert restart_surface, restart sample, focused tests/docs, and RTS-FRZ-000012 lifecycle revisions only. Do not alter Child A or full-history sources.
completion_conditions: Required restart fields survive compaction exactly.
Over-budget surfaces fail closed instead of truncating.
Stale or escaped source pointers fail closed.
Restart-equivalence detects any missing or changed required state.
Explicit uncertainty and do-not-touch state remain representable.
Reopen-full-history and selective-recall routes are explicit and non-authorizing.
All focused and existing FREEZER tests pass.
Child B reaches COMPLETED while C-E remain FROZEN/NOT_APPROVED.
risks: A shorter surface can look successful while losing restart competence.
Self-referential current-head claims are not allowed; source commit is an explicit input identity.
Future callers could bypass equivalence validation.
